title: Constant segmentation faults on OS X

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:
- `nvim --version`: 0.1.4
- Vim (version: ) behaves differently? I have not checked vim
- Operating system/version: osx el capitan
- Terminal name/version: iterm2 (xonsh shell)
- `$TERM`: xterm-256color
### Actual behaviour

nvim segfaults randomly. No error message shows up, just the Segmentation fault one.
### Expected behaviour

Well, it should not segfault
### Steps to reproduce using `nvim -u NORC`

It just happens randomly. Here's a few core dumps
